title: Ferric Carboxymaltose for Anemic Perioperative Populations: A Systematic Literature Review of Randomized Controlled Trials
design_evidence: We conducted a systematic literature review (SLR) to determine the efficacy and safety of the use of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose (FCM) for the treatment of perioperative anemia in preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative elective surgical care. Studies meeting inclusion criteria for the SLR reported on treatment efficacy in an adult study population randomly allocated to FCM
population: adult study population undergoing elective surgical procedures (colorectal, gastric, orthopedic, abdominal, urologic, plastic, neck, gynecologic, and otolaryngologic procedures) with perioperative anemia
